description: Canonical source-of-truth for the skill-mesh package: one record per published skill. Consumed by distribution, installation, integrity, and README-count generation.
legacy_migration_root: coding-root (aberson/coding-root at the operator's checkout, READ-ONLY during Steps 33-40). Every 'source'/'legacy_*' path in this manifest is relative to that root: the '.claude/...' trees and 'documentation/multi-model/...' are both direct children of coding-root.

capability_semantics.filesystem: The skill reads and/or writes workspace files as an intrinsic part of its contract (plan docs, state files, reports, evals, or source edits). True for every skill in this package.
capability_semantics.sub-agent: The skill's core workflow requires dispatching one or more isolated fresh-context sub-agents -- the host Agent/Task primitive, a Workflow agent() call, or provider action children (e.g. parallel judge/reviewer fan-out or a separate vision-judge). A named-skill dispatch (/other-skill) does NOT count. A local text-only model cannot satisfy this, so sub-agent implies local_capable=false.
capability_semantics.vision: The skill requires a native image/vision capability (screenshot or filmstrip judging). Implies local_capable=false.

host_metadata_sources.description: Approved trustworthy host-identity environment variables the neutral router (-Provider auto) may consult in Step 37. Explicit host-set environment metadata ONLY: no executable-name guessing, and credential variables are excluded because a credential can be exported in any environment and does not identify the active host.

claude.rule: present if any listed marker is set with its expected value

gpt.rule: present if any listed marker is set with its expected value

precedence: If exactly one provider's markers are present -> select it.
If BOTH providers' markers are present -> ambiguous: error (exit 2), never default to Claude.
If NEITHER is present -> unset/unsupported: error (exit 2) instructing an explicit -Provider claude|gpt.

global_support_assets.note: cross-skill grader/scoring assets + judge-core.md; only skills/_shared exists (no skills-gpt/_shared)
existing operator guides; coding-root-relative (sibling of .claude, NOT under it)

skills.name: build-phase
skills.description: Orchestrate a multi-step build phase end-to-end: run each plan step through build-step in order, gate quality between steps, and report progress.

skills.name: build-queue
skills.description: Queue and run multiple pending phase plans unattended, isolating each in its own worktree and parking any halt as a GitHub issue.

skills.name: build-step
skills.description: Execute one build step end-to-end: a developer agent writes the change, isolated reviewers gate it, and the result merges.

skills.name: claude-oauth-auth
skills.description: How to authenticate with Claude using a subscription OAuth token instead of an API key.

skills.name: context-slim
skills.description: Audit a project's auto-loaded context files and produce a prioritized progressive-disclosure plan to cut per-turn token cost.

skills.name: goblin-do
skills.description: Single front door for a chosen goblin atom: execute a small suggestion or safe UAT task via build-step, or hand a big one to the plan rail.

skills.name: goblin-suggest
skills.description: Produce a grounded, ranked improvement shortlist for a project and persist it as goblin suggestion atoms.

skills.name: judge-motion
skills.description: Capture a UI transition as a slow-motion filmstrip and have a vision-judge render a PASS/FAIL/ESCALATE verdict on motion defects.

skills.name: judge-ui
skills.description: Drive a web UI through a flow, capture screenshots plus a structured read-back, and have an independent vision-judge render PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN.

skills.name: lesson-harvest
skills.description: Scan recent git history and run-logs for un-codified regressions and draft codification candidates as a review-ready PR.

skills.name: memory-distill
skills.description: Review recent feedback memories one at a time and surface the latent principles several of them point at.

skills.name: observatory-doctor
skills.description: Health-check every launcher button on the dev-observatory dashboard and report which project verbs actually work.

skills.name: plan-expedite
skills.description: Chain plan-review, plan-wrap, repo-sync, and task-handoff into one autonomous prep step before build-phase.

skills.name: plan-feature
skills.description: Plan a new feature or phase for an existing project by reading its code and docs, then producing a scoped plan document.

skills.name: plan-init
skills.description: Guide creation of a new project plan through a structured up-front conversation about stack, storage, auth, and tooling.

skills.name: plan-merge
skills.description: Merge two overlapping plan documents into one coherent plan, resolving sequencing and deleting subsumed phases.

skills.name: plan-redline
skills.description: Render a just-authored plan into an operator-facing proposal with every choice labeled operator-picked or agent-defaulted.

skills.name: plan-review
skills.description: Review a plan for gaps, missing pieces, unresolved decisions, and risks, validating claims against existing code.

skills.name: plan-trim
skills.description: Investigate a project's state and propose plan items to cut or fold together, then execute the trim once confirmed.

skills.name: plan-wrap
skills.description: Check whether a plan or document is self-contained for a fresh model with no prior conversation history.

skills.name: repo-init
skills.description: Publish a local project to GitHub: initialize git, create the remote, add a README, and convert the plan into issues.

skills.name: repo-sync
skills.description: Sync GitHub issues to match a plan's structure with rich, fresh-context issue bodies.

skills.name: repo-update
skills.description: End-to-end docs and git update after a phase: refresh README and plan, run plan-wrap, update memory, commit, and push.

skills.name: research-prospect
skills.description: Scan active projects and surface high-value research topic strings per project for hand-off to separate windows.

skills.name: review-deep
skills.description: Six-lens code review (correctness, bugs, security, tests, style, plan-conformance) with severity, evidence, and a JSON audit trail.

skills.name: review-gauntlet
skills.description: Lean multi-lens code-review profile over review-deep's engine that emits a terse PASS/NEEDS-WORK verdict.

skills.name: review-proof
skills.description: Enforce evidence-based responses by requiring primary-source verification before making any claim.

skills.name: review-uat
skills.description: Refine a UAT script so every step is unambiguous and only the checks that genuinely need a human stay on the human.

skills.name: session-wrap
skills.description: The session-transition front door: triage context, task state, and git, then continue, recycle, or close the window.

skills.name: skill-eval-setup
skills.description: Auto-generate an evaluation framework for a skill by reading its contract, then output a ready-to-run self-improvement loop.

skills.name: skill-evolve
skills.description: A/B-test several variant mutations of a skill in parallel worktrees and compare, pushing the winner for review.

skills.name: skill-iterate
skills.description: Serial hill-climb every scorable skill autonomously, capped per skill by wall-clock or iteration budget.

skills.name: task-handoff
skills.description: Checkpoint library that orchestrators call to save session state and regenerate the derived current-task rollup.

skills.name: test-prune
skills.description: Audit a test suite for redundant, trivial, or mock-theater tests, relocating sole-coverage ones and deleting the rest.

skills.name: tier-escalate
skills.description: Scan skills to find which single load-bearing seed-artifact phase warrants escalating a session to a higher-tier model, and emit a map.

skills.name: tier-offload
skills.description: Scan skills to find which sub-tasks are safe to offload to a local model, and emit an offload inventory plus a router config.

skills.name: user-afterparty
skills.description: Milestone workspace-hygiene front door that chains the hygiene skills into one report and walks the operator through cleanup.

skills.name: user-brainstorm
skills.description: Brainstorm a topic end-to-end, gap-fill through rounds, then dispatch one sub-agent per topic to write a reference doc set.

skills.name: user-debug
skills.description: Diagnose and fix a bug end-to-end with forced primary-source investigation before any code change.

skills.name: user-draft
skills.description: Refine rough thoughts into a polished prompt or a ready-to-paste goal condition, checkpointing state along the way.

skills.name: user-gateway
skills.description: Pre-work intake gateway that converts an operator vent into routed, ledger-backed work with a ready-to-paste seed per row.

skills.name: user-lavishify
skills.description: Escalate the last output into a richer, more thorough on-demand deliverable without changing the default chat-first style.

skills.name: user-learn
skills.description: Scaffold a hands-on learning ramp for a topic with a knowledge base, runnable notebooks, exercises, and a progress tracker.

skills.name: user-orient
skills.description: Re-orient on the session axis with a verified status snapshot of what we were doing and what is left.

skills.name: user-pm
skills.description: Tight PM-lens overview on the project axis: what shipped, what is planned, what is next, and what could be cut.

skills.name: user-project
skills.description: Pin the session's active project so pipeline skills target the right repo regardless of the current directory.

skills.name: user-shakedown
skills.description: Shake down a just-built tool or feature to surface rough edges before formal acceptance.

skills.name: user-uat
skills.description: Run an already-clear UAT block for the operator, executing steps and auto-judging the mechanically checkable ones.

skills.name: user-walkthrough
skills.description: Attended, operator-driven acceptance of a just-built tool where the agent answers from primary source and fixes small things in place.

skills.name: user-wrap
skills.description: The return-moment front door for sitting back down: orient, get a keep-going-or-wrap verdict, and act on it.
